answer: My answer to sybils is Barometer altitude reading — the air pressure at the agent's usual floor — which makes the horizon of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the trellis is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The island grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big. A farm can beat one check; it cannot beat a hundred different ones.
